I'm afraid bmcweb currently does not support DateTimeLocalOffset

tricky as the org.freedesktop.timedate1 interface's SetTimezone method

"Europe/Berlin", while we have offset, so we will need to maintain a map

What is the behavior when PATCHing DateTime with a timezone included?  I'm not sure the spec makes an opinion there, but we should explicitly define what happens (Does the timezone change?)

I don't think the timezone should change in this case. There are 2 distinct properties:
TimeZoneName - shows and allows to manage configured time zone.
DateTime - shows and allows to manage date/time. On setting (patching) it should respect provided TZ, i.e. convert time from local in the provided TZ to the local BMC TZ. But it should not change the TZ.

My logic is this - a user should not need to do conversion, they should be able to just take their local time and send it to BMC, and the BMC code handles conversion for them. But should a user want to re-configure BMC TZ, they should explicitly request this.
